meaning: A person trained to treat sick people.
example: I have an appointment with the doctor at five.
exampleTamil: எனக்கு ஐந்து மணிக்கு மருத்துவரைப் பார்க்க நேரம் இருக்கு.

meaning: A hurting feeling in your body.
example: I have a sharp pain in my leg.

meaning: The front part of the body between neck and stomach.
example: He felt a tightness in his chest.

meaning: The part that joins your head to your body.
example: My neck hurts after long hours at the computer.
exampleTamil: கணினியில் நீண்ட நேரம் வேலை செய்ததால் என் கழுத்து வலிக்குது.

meaning: The rear part of the body from shoulders to hips.
example: I have a pain in my lower back.

meaning: The outer covering of the body.
example: Drink water to keep your skin healthy.

meaning: A hard part of the body that forms the skeleton.
example: He broke a bone in his hand.

meaning: Body tissue that helps you move.
example: I pulled a muscle while playing cricket.
exampleTamil: கிரிக்கெட் விளையாடும்போது எனக்கு தசை பிடிப்பு ஏற்பட்டது.

meaning: The red liquid that flows in the body.
example: The nurse took a blood sample.

meaning: The organ that pumps blood.
example: My grandfather has a weak heart.

meaning: The two organs in your chest used for breathing.
example: Smoking damages your lungs.

meaning: The organ in your head that controls thinking.
example: Exercise is good for your brain too.

meaning: One of the hard white parts in your mouth for chewing.
example: My tooth has been hurting since morning.

meaning: A place where sick people get treatment.
example: They took him to the hospital immediately.
exampleTamil: அவர்கள் அவனை உடனே மருத்துவமனைக்குக் கொண்டு போனார்கள்.

meaning: A sickness caused by germs.
example: The wound got an infection.

meaning: A disease with too much sugar in the blood.
example: My uncle has diabetes, so he avoids sweets.
exampleTamil: என் மாமாவுக்கு சர்க்கரை நோய், அதனால் இனிப்பைத் தவிர்க்கிறார்.

meaning: Exercise with stretching and breathing for body and mind.
example: I do yoga every morning before work.
exampleTamil: நான் தினமும் காலை வேலைக்கு முன் யோகா செய்கிறேன்.

meaning: The food you usually eat, or a special eating plan.
example: The doctor told him to follow a low-salt diet.
exampleTamil: உப்பு குறைவான உணவுமுறையைப் பின்பற்ற மருத்துவர் அவனிடம் சொன்னார்.

meaning: A natural substance in food that your body needs.
example: Oranges are full of vitamin C.

meaning: To rest with your eyes closed at night.
example: I could not sleep well last night.
exampleTamil: நேற்று இரவு எனக்கு நல்லா தூக்கம் வரலை.

meaning: To make a sick person well again.
example: This medicine will cure your cold.

meaning: A part of the body that becomes bigger because of injury.
example: There is a swelling on his foot.

meaning: Strong and not sick.
example: Eating fruits keeps you healthy.

meaning: Not well; having an illness.
example: She stayed home because she was sick.

meaning: How heavy a person or thing is.
example: He wants to lose some weight.
